verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only human-facing web search, a publication platform for submitting orders, and a note that structured data retrieval is an unbinding service. Nothing documents a system-to-system channel such as system accounts, transmitter programs or batch providers, and no enrollment path is published.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
